about.title: Westmorland Slip & Fall & Premises Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Westmorland is a small farming community, and many of its public spaces — corner markets along W Main Street, gas stations near Rt 85, agricultural supply lots — see a mix of foot traffic and uneven surfaces that can turn a routine errand into an injury. When a property owner or manager fails to fix a known spill, broken step, or poor lighting, and someone gets hurt because of it, California law may allow that injured person to seek compensation. These claims hinge on proving the owner knew or reasonably should have known about the hazard and didn't act. That often means gathering evidence quickly — photos of the exact spot, incident reports, and any surveillance footage before it's erased. LawProactive doesn't handle claims itself; we're a free service that connects you with an independent local attorney who can evaluate what happened, explain your options, and work on a contingency basis so you owe nothing unless you recover.
